title: Prompts in LangChain
text:
Welcome to another video of the LangChain Series! 🌙

In this session, we’re diving into one of the most essential concepts when working with LLMs — Prompts in LangChain! 💬

✅ What Prompts are and how they work in LangChain

title: AI Funding Crisis? Oracle’s AI Push Explained: Huge Costs, Big Risks & Uncertain Returns
text:
In this Be Rich episode, Vinod Srinivasan and Anand Srinivasan explains the rising risks in the global AI boom and why Oracle’s massive $300–350 billion bet on AI data farms could trigger a major financial stress. Drawing from a detailed Financial Times report, Vinod and Anand break down how OpenAI has become Oracle’s only major future customer, why the company is taking on heavy debt, and how this mirrors past bubbles from the railway mania to the dot-com crash. They discuss why even great minds like Darwin and Newton lost money in similar hype cycles, and why today’s AI frenzy may end the same way. Vinod highlights the fall in Oracle’s stock, the uncertainty around OpenAI’s future, and why investors should be cautious and stick to strong players like Google and Microsoft. A must-watch for anyone tracking AI, tech investing, or the AGI race.

title: My  Rag day Memory (67th Batch SAU)
Day 3: AI Agents Intensive with Google – Context Engineering: Sessions & Memory
text:
How AI Agents Remember 🧠 | Building Short-Term & Long-Term Memory Systems

In this video, we explore how to create AI agents that can remember past interactions, maintain context, and handle complex multi-turn conversations just like a real assistant.

You’ll learn the difference between short-term memory, long-term memory, and how modern AI systems store, retrieve, and use information to respond intelligently. We break down practical techniques you can implement—whether you're using Notebook LM, custom agents, or advanced frameworks.

🔍 What You’ll Learn:

How AI agents remember past interactions

The role of short-term vs long-term memory

Memory architectures used in modern AI systems

How to maintain context across multi-turn tasks

Practical examples of building memory-powered agents

Why memory is essential for robust, intelligent agent behavior

This is perfect for developers, students, and anyone building smarter, more persistent AI systems.

title: ISTQB CT-GenAI Chapter 2 | Prompt Engineering | Part 5 | System Prompt & User Prompt بالعربي
text:
💻 System Prompt vs. User Prompt

As a quality tester, you must know that the success of Generative AI GenAI hinges on two commands:

1. System Prompt
Description: This is the "internal constitution" or the hidden instructions provided to the model in advance to set its identity, behavior, and boundaries.
Tester's Role: This is where you define complex testing roles. Example: "You are a demanding quality assurance expert, and your task is to find 5 critical test cases in every output."
Goal: To control the model's persona, tone, and general response style.

2. User Prompt
Description: This is the "direct request" that you input as a user to get a specific task or answer.
Tester's Role: This is where you enter the actual requirements, test scenarios, and input data. Example: "Evaluate the performance of this function on negative inputs."
*Goal:* To receive an *immediate response* for a specific task.
Agenda:

00:00  Introduction
00:20  Trying to get the System Prompt of ChatGPT
02:30  System Prompt Definition
04:40  ChatGPT PlayGround
06:35  User Prompt Definition
07:15  User Prompt Usage & Context
08:15  Negative Prompt
11:40  Context Window Awareness
16:03  Lost in the Middle

The Takeaway: The System Prompt determines who the AI is. The User Prompt determines what it does right now. Learn how to control both to turn GenAI into your most efficient testing assistant!
